technical.summary: Mixed momentum setup with strong trend confirmation (ADX, Hull MA) and volume spike, but undermined by price below intermediate moving averages, negative money flow, and overbought stochastic RSI in neutral sector.

fundamental.summary: TECH shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning, absent government contracts, no lobbying footprint, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 92 days present material risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market in fear state (38/100) with bearish retail sentiment (53%) creates potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (476+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (317.44) dominates risk assessment despite normal yield curve; earnings in 92 days presents moderate binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX strong trend confirmation + Hull MA flip up + 15x volume spike create technical momentum setup in fear-zone market with potential contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below both 50-day moving averages, negative money flow, overbought stochastic RSI, VIX crisis regime (317.44), zero fundamental conviction, and high earnings risk in 92 days overwhelm technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (ADX strong, Hull flip, 15x volume) offers entry signal, but price below both 50-day MAs and negative money flow undermine conviction. Fear-zone market creates contrarian opportunity, but risk/reward unfavorable.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (317.44) combined with earnings binary event in 92 days and price below intermediate moving averages creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already 35 positions in Health Care sector (16% of portfolio); adding TECH increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector without fundamental conviction.
